degenerateReason: A string function over a non-string operand is a CEL type error that denies every seed. A store coercing the number to text would return rows.
intent: startsWith() on a string attribute with a numeric attribute as the prefix (R.attr.aString.startsWith(R.attr.aNumber)).
trap: A non-string needle is a CEL error; building the LIKE pattern from the number coerces it to text and returns rows.
